research.topic: Run 44 — final homepage and section composition
research.conclusion: The final supported six-card composition leads with the delta-first September 8 edition and keeps one distinct Lebanon canonical story. Fake Resistance pairs a current major investigation with a practical methods guide. People pairs a society and healthcare investigation with a peer-reviewed Israeli science result. No slot repeats one event family. October 7 and historical companions cannot be placed through the three supported homepage areas and remain reachable through their sections or article inventory rather than being falsely reported as featured.

siteRecommendations: RUN 44 OCTOBER 7/HISTORY COMPOSITION: the supported homepage contract exposes only news, fakeResistance and people. Acceptance: provide an editorially controlled, source-safe way to feature the verified October 7 location/timeline companions and historical reading room without changing or overwriting archive originals.

RUN 44 STATIC SURFACE BACKLOG: apply the previously recorded corrections and disclosures to /israels-story, /methodology, /corrections, /support-us, ticker and static Fake Resistance cases. Acceptance: each original surface displays the corrected language and visible change history; companion articles alone do not count as repair.

RUN 44 REVISION CACHE: several updated records briefly served stale HTML after the production API held the new version. Acceptance: article, card and homepage caches invalidate atomically on revision, and verification can read the same version identifier on all three surfaces.
